description: Exact port of nera-data-layer connection_service_architecture at 2b1504adc4291daaf080b2e932962b134da1a69a.

stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,NULL AS alias,NULL AS module,ast_value AS value,ast_value_kind AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(ast_index,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(ast_end,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,NULL AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,ast_context AS context,ast_name_repr AS name_repr,ast_value_repr AS value_repr,NULL AS annotation,NULL AS annotation_repr FROM canonical

stages.name: calls
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.name AS callee,f.id AS callee_id,r.id AS receiver,r.kind AS receiver_kind,r.name AS receiver_name
      FROM a c JOIN a f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.parent=c.id AND f.field='func'
      LEFT JOIN a r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.parent=f.id AND r.field='value'
      WHERE c.kind='Call'

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: parameters
stages.query: SELECT p.* FROM a p JOIN a arguments ON arguments.__path=p.__path AND arguments.id=p.parent AND arguments.kind='arguments' JOIN functions f ON f.__path=arguments.__path AND f.id=arguments.parent WHERE p.kind='arg'

stages.name: methods
stages.query: SELECT f.*,c.name AS class_name FROM functions f JOIN a c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.id=f.parent AND c.kind='ClassDef' WHERE f.field='body'

stages.name: decorators
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE d(__path,fn,root,id) AS (
      SELECT __path,parent,id,id FROM a WHERE field='decorator_list'
      UNION ALL SELECT d.__path,d.fn,d.root,n.id FROM d JOIN a n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.parent=d.id AND n.field='func'
      JOIN a c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.id AND c.kind='Call')
      SELECT d.__path,d.fn,d.root,n.id,n.kind,n.name FROM d JOIN a n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.id WHERE n.kind IN ('Name','Attribute')

stages.name: body
stages.query: SELECT b.* FROM a b WHERE field='body' AND NOT (b.position=0 AND b.kind='Expr' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a v WHERE v.__path=b.__path AND v.parent=b.id AND v.field='value' AND v.kind='Constant' AND v.value_kind='str'))

stages.name: bodies
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.id,count(b.id) AS body_count,min(b.id) AS first_body,max(b.id) AS last_body FROM functions f LEFT JOIN body b ON b.__path=f.__path AND b.parent=f.id GROUP BY f.__path,f.id

stages.name: service_classes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,CASE WHEN substr(n.name,-8)='Protocol' OR substr(n.name,-8)='Contract' OR substr(n.name,-4)='Plan' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a b WHERE b.__path=n.__path AND b.parent=n.id AND b.field='bases' AND b.kind IN ('Name','Attribute') AND b.name IN ('Protocol','TypedDict')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS abstract FROM a n WHERE kind='ClassDef' AND parent=0

stages.name: service_methods
stages.query: SELECT m.*,c.abstract FROM methods m JOIN service_classes c ON c.__path=m.__path AND c.id=m.parent

stages.name: latest_methods
stages.query: SELECT m.*,(SELECT min(x.id) FROM service_methods x WHERE x.__path=m.__path AND x.parent=m.parent AND x.name=m.name) AS insertion FROM service_methods m WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM service_methods x WHERE x.__path=m.__path AND x.parent=m.parent AND x.name=m.name AND x.id>m.id)

stages.name: name_decorators
stages.query: SELECT * FROM decorators WHERE kind='Name'

stages.name: slot_aliases
stages.query:
SELECT n.__path,n.fn,t.name,n.id FROM a n JOIN a t ON t.__path=n.__path AND t.parent=n.id AND t.field IN ('target','targets') AND t.kind='Name' JOIN a v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id AND v.field='value'
 WHERE n.kind IN ('Assign','AnnAssign') AND n.fn IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a k WHERE k.__path=v.__path AND k.id BETWEEN v.id AND v.last AND k.kind='Constant' AND k.value_kind='str' AND k.value IN ('_current_async_schema_transaction','_current_schema_transaction'))

stages.name: slot_probes
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,v.name AS probe_name,v.name_repr AS probe_repr FROM calls c JOIN a v ON v.__path=c.__path AND v.parent=c.id AND v.field='args' AND v.position=CASE WHEN c.callee IN ('getattr','hasattr') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
 WHERE (c.callee IN ('getattr','hasattr') OR c.callee_kind='Attribute' AND c.callee='get' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls receiver WHERE receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.id=c.receiver AND receiver.callee='vars'))
 AND v.kind='Name' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM slot_aliases s WHERE s.__path=c.__path AND s.fn=c.fn AND s.name=v.name AND s.id<c.id)
 UNION ALL SELECT c.*,v.value,v.value_repr FROM calls c JOIN a v ON v.__path=c.__path AND v.parent=c.id AND v.field='args' AND v.position=CASE WHEN c.callee IN ('getattr','hasattr') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
 WHERE (c.callee IN ('getattr','hasattr') OR c.callee_kind='Attribute' AND c.callee='get' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls receiver WHERE receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.id=c.receiver AND receiver.callee='vars')) AND v.kind='Constant' AND v.value_kind='str' AND v.value IN ('_current_async_schema_transaction','_current_schema_transaction')

stages.name: delegates
stages.query:
SELECT m.__path,m.id FROM service_methods m JOIN bodies b ON b.__path=m.__path AND b.id=m.id JOIN body first ON first.__path=b.__path AND first.id=b.first_body JOIN body last ON last.__path=b.__path AND last.id=b.last_body
 LEFT JOIN a v ON v.__path=last.__path AND v.parent=last.id AND v.field='value'
 WHERE last.kind='Raise' OR b.body_count=1 AND (first.kind='Pass' OR first.kind='Expr' AND v.kind='Constant' AND v.value_kind='ellipsis')
 OR (b.body_count=1 AND first.kind IN ('Expr','Return') OR b.body_count=2 AND first.kind='Expr' AND last.kind='Return') AND (v.kind='Call' OR v.kind='Await' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a x WHERE x.__path=v.__path AND x.parent=v.id AND x.field='value' AND x.kind='Call'))

stages.name: owners
stages.query: SELECT m.* FROM service_methods m LEFT JOIN delegates d ON d.__path=m.__path AND d.id=m.id WHERE NOT m.abstract AND (m.name IN ('introspect_table','introspect_table_async','table_exists','table_exists_async','table_exists_many','table_exists_many_async','trigger_exists','trigger_exists_async') OR substr(m.name,1,8)='_schema_') AND d.id IS NULL

stages.name: owner_groups
stages.query: SELECT __path,name,count(*) count,group_concat(class_name,', ') names FROM (SELECT * FROM owners ORDER BY id) GROUP BY __path,name

stages.name: legacy
stages.query:
SELECT m.*,d.name AS decorator,d.root AS decorator_id,CASE d.name WHEN 'legacy_sync' THEN '_legacy_delegate_stub' ELSE '_legacy_delegate_stub_async' END AS stub,
 coalesce(NULLIF((SELECT v.value FROM a k JOIN a v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.parent=k.id AND v.field='value' JOIN name_decorators other ON other.__path=k.__path AND other.root=k.parent AND other.fn=m.id AND other.name=d.name WHERE k.__path=d.__path AND k.field='keywords' AND k.name='lazy_name' AND v.kind='Constant' AND v.value_kind='str' ORDER BY other.root,k.position LIMIT 1),''),CASE WHEN d.name='legacy_async' AND substr(m.name,-6)='_async' THEN substr(m.name,1,length(m.name)-6)||'_lazy' ELSE m.name||'_lazy' END) AS lazy_name
 FROM latest_methods m JOIN (SELECT __path,fn,name,min(root) root FROM name_decorators GROUP BY __path,fn,name) d ON d.__path=m.__path AND d.fn=m.id WHERE NOT m.abstract AND d.name IN ('legacy_sync','legacy_async') AND CASE WHEN (SELECT name FROM service_entry) NOT IN ('all','lint','analyze_source') OR m.abstract THEN 1 WHEN (SELECT count(DISTINCT check_decorator.name) FROM name_decorators check_decorator WHERE check_decorator.__path=m.__path AND check_decorator.fn=m.id AND check_decorator.name IN ('legacy_sync','legacy_async'))<=1 THEN 1 ELSE json_extract('[]','$[legacy decorator cardinality]') END

stages.name: lazy_counterparts
stages.query:
SELECT l.__path,l.id,coalesce(own.id,fallback.id) AS counterpart FROM legacy l LEFT JOIN latest_methods own ON own.__path=l.__path AND own.parent=l.parent AND own.name=l.lazy_name
 LEFT JOIN latest_methods fallback ON fallback.__path=l.__path AND fallback.class_name='LazySchemaTransaction' AND fallback.name=l.lazy_name AND l.class_name IN ('SyncSchemaTransaction','AsyncSchemaTransaction') AND fallback.parent=(SELECT min(c.id) FROM service_classes c WHERE c.__path=l.__path AND c.name='LazySchemaTransaction')

stages.name: first_classes
stages.query: SELECT c.* FROM service_classes c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM service_classes x WHERE x.__path=c.__path AND x.name=c.name AND x.id<c.id)

stages.name: first_methods
stages.query: SELECT m.* FROM service_methods m JOIN first_classes c ON c.__path=m.__path AND c.id=m.parent WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM service_methods x WHERE x.__path=m.__path AND x.parent=m.parent AND x.name=m.name AND x.id<m.id)

stages.name: required_services
stages.query: SELECT column1 ordinal,column2 owner,column3 method FROM (VALUES (0,'SqlSessionContextService','_assert_sync_io_allowed'),(0,'SqlSessionContextService','_finalize_commit_branch_ripple_context'),(0,'SqlSessionContextService','_finalize_commit_branch_ripple_context_async'),(0,'SqlSessionContextService','_raise_if_pending_active_plan_for_immediate_sql'),(1,'SqlMaintenanceService','_execute_analyze'),(1,'SqlMaintenanceService','_reset_plan_flush_ctx'),(1,'SqlMaintenanceService','enable_query_prerender_cache'),(1,'SqlMaintenanceService','get_query_prerender_cache_statistics'),(1,'SqlMaintenanceService','native_pipeline'))

stages.name: expected_backends
stages.query: SELECT column1 ordinal,column2 path,column3 owner FROM (VALUES (0,'impl/sqlite/connection.py','_SqliteConnectionCore'),(1,'impl/postgres/connection.py','_PostgresConnectionCore'),(2,'impl/mariadb/connection.py','_MariaDBConnectionCore'))

stages.name: file_order
stages.query: SELECT value path,CAST(key AS INTEGER) ordinal FROM service_configuration,json_each(data,'$.fileOrder')

cases.all: SELECT * FROM owners WHERE substr(__path,1,17)='l2000_connection/' OR substr(__path,1,30)='impl/common/l2200_sql_dialect/' OR __path IN ('impl/sqlite/connection.py','impl/postgres/connection.py','impl/mariadb/connection.py','impl/common/l5150_fts_polyfill/manager.py')

stages.name: cross_owner_groups
stages.query:
SELECT name,count(DISTINCT __path||':'||class_name) distinct_owners,group_concat(display_path||':'||class_name,', ') names FROM (
 SELECT o.*,coalesce(json_extract(p.data,'$.displayPaths.'||json_quote(o.__path)),o.__path) display_path FROM broad_owners o CROSS JOIN service_configuration p
 LEFT JOIN file_order ord ON ord.path=o.__path ORDER BY coalesce(ord.ordinal,2147483647),o.__path,o.id) GROUP BY name

message,n.id||':CONN601:'||(n.id+0.0003) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id+0.0003 AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM calls n JOIN a v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id AND v.field='args' AND v.position=0 WHERE n.__path='impl/read_through/connection.py' AND n.callee='getattr' AND v.kind='Attribute' AND v.name IN ('_cache','_upstream') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a x WHERE x.__path=v.__path stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,NULL AS alias,NULL AS module,ast_value AS value,ast_value_kind AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,NULL AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,NULL AS context,NULL AS name_repr,NULL AS value_repr,NULL AS annotation,NULL AS annotation_repr FROM canonical

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: methods
stages.query: SELECT f.*,c.name AS class_name FROM functions f JOIN a c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.id=f.parent AND c.kind='ClassDef' WHERE f.field='body'

stages.name: decorators
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE d(__path,fn,root,id) AS (
      SELECT __path,parent,id,id FROM a WHERE field='decorator_list'
      UNION ALL SELECT d.__path,d.fn,d.root,n.id FROM d JOIN a n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.parent=d.id AND n.field='func'
      JOIN a c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.id AND c.kind='Call')
      SELECT d.__path,d.fn,d.root,n.id,n.kind,n.name FROM d JOIN a n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.id WHERE n.kind IN ('Name','Attribute')

stages.name: service_classes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,CASE WHEN substr(n.name,-8)='Protocol' OR substr(n.name,-8)='Contract' OR substr(n.name,-4)='Plan' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a b WHERE b.__path=n.__path AND b.parent=n.id AND b.field='bases' AND b.kind IN ('Name','Attribute') AND b.name IN ('Protocol','TypedDict')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS abstract FROM a n WHERE kind='ClassDef' AND parent=0

stages.name: service_methods
stages.query: SELECT m.*,c.abstract FROM methods m JOIN service_classes c ON c.__path=m.__path AND c.id=m.parent

stages.name: name_decorators
stages.query: SELECT * FROM decorators WHERE kind='Name'

stages.name: first_classes
stages.query: SELECT c.* FROM service_classes c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM service_classes x WHERE x.__path=c.__path AND x.name=c.name AND x.id<c.id)

stages.name: first_methods
stages.query: SELECT m.* FROM service_methods m JOIN first_classes c ON c.__path=m.__path AND c.id=m.parent WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM service_methods x WHERE x.__path=m.__path AND x.parent=m.parent AND x.name=m.name AND x.id<m.id)
